title: 10. Numeracy & Number Systems: Estimating Differences of Whole Numbers
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.learningObjective: Estimate a difference of two two-digit numbers by rounding each number to the nearest ten.
questions.question: Estimate \(68-23\) by rounding each number to the nearest ten. What estimate do you get?
questions.explanation: Round \(68\) to the nearest ten: \(68\) rounds to \(70\). Round \(23\) to the nearest ten: \(23\) rounds to \(20\). Then subtract the rounded numbers: \(70-20=50\). Therefore, the estimate is \(50\).
questions.hint: For each number, check its ones digit: \(0\) to \(4\) keeps the tens digit, \(5\) to \(9\) raises it by one. Subtract the two rounded numbers, not the original ones.
